content.thinking: I've reviewed 10 of 13 screens; so far the page lists the 125 fund under "פסגות" and picks one fund as its best match. I'm checking the last three screens before writing it up.

content.text:
**What I decided:** I'd open the account at **פסגות (Psagot)** and buy **"אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125"** (number 5112628). On the page's own example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years at 7%, I'd end up with about **86,045 ₪** after fees and tax, against 70,000 ₪ put in. I'm fairly sure about the account and the fund. I'm less sure about the amount, because those aren't my numbers. My 30,000 would come out higher, but I don't know by how much. The amount boxes on the screenshots were stuck at the page's 10,000 and 500, so I couldn't set my own.

**The one thing that decided it:** the page's own summary near the bottom: "הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים: 86,045 ₪, אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125, פסגות." It also had it starred as "הזול" ("the cheapest") right at the top. I've seen Psagot in ads, so the name doesn't put me off.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Big heading** about the cheapest way to invest in an index. "ת"א-125" was already picked. I saw the 10,000 and 500 boxes, return set to 7%.
- **The money box:** "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪" and "הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,045 ₪". Next to it was the second-best pair at 85,015, with "−1,030 ₪".
- **The cost bar and the "18 ₪ יותר / 1,390 ₪ פחות / 342 ₪ יותר" bit:** skimmed.
- **The list of accounts:** Psagot 86,045 at the top, then לאומי (Leumi) 82,968 and the other banks lower down. I hesitated at Leumi because it's a bank I know, but it's about 3,000 less. I didn't open any of the "לא בחישוב" folds.
- **The fund card:** "דמי ניהול 0.1%", plus a "נאמן 0.025%" I didn't get. Then the list of 125 funds with minus signs everywhere.
- **The chart with coloured lines and the "what if" table:** glanced. All I took from it was "12 שנים, 18,905 ₪ יותר".
- **The steps chart:** confusing. It starts from "הראל סל, ירושלים 79,910" and adds up to 86,045 again, which at least confirmed my pick.
- **The bottom:** skipped the small notes and "חוקים וכללים".

**Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "נאמן", "4A", "(40)", "MTF", "משתנים" next to the fee, "בכסף של היום". I'm also not sure "קרן מחקה" and "קרן סל" are really different things.

**What I wasn't sure I read right, and what bothered me:**
- The "−0.04%" right under my chosen fund. It looks like the fund loses money every year.
- The other funds showed "−1,030 ₪" and "−1,733 ₪". I think that means "less than your choice", but at first it read like a loss.
- In the cost box, "המס 342 ₪ יותר" (more tax) sounds bad, even though it's sitting on the winning option.
- The steps chart suddenly starts at 79,910 at Harel/Jerusalem. For a second I thought my number had changed.
- Too many 125 funds that look almost the same. If the page hadn't starred one, I'd have done nothing today.
- I got bored around the chart with the coloured lines and would've closed the page there, if not for the summary line further down.
